integrity: Complete direct proof for every q>=2 and integer R>=1; finite exact checker included; no independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only the first blocklength at which insertion covering fails to force deletion covering; does not give minimum covering-code sizes, reverse implication thresholds, or a classification of every boundary code. title: Sharp alphabet threshold for insertion-covering versus deletion-covering implication
